note: Hoonah-Angoon Census Area is an unorganized borough with no borough government, so the county does not zone. Searches of ArcGIS Hub/Online and the web found no queryable zoning district layer for the county or its cities (Hoonah, Angoon, Tenakee Springs, Pelican). The City of Hoonah planning page describes a zoning commission and ordinance but links no GIS service or zoning map layer.
